fee_schedule.locator: Rule 7(2), fee table as substituted in 2023
fee_schedule.basis: value of goods or services paid as consideration, not compensation demanded
fee_schedule.limitation: Indicative fee calculation from the checked schedule, not confirmation of admissibility or total cost. Reverify the current applicable schedule before filing.

pecuniary_jurisdiction.limitation: Pecuniary band only; territorial jurisdiction, consumer status, valuation, timing and other proceedings require separate checks.

future_provisions.limitation: Do not apply future requirements before commencement or infer retrospective effect.
